newsitem.title: UK: UK's CBI welcomes report on corporate governance.
newsitem.headline: UK's CBI welcomes report on corporate governance.

text.p: The Confederation of British Industry (CBI) on Tuesday welcomed the findings of the Hampel committee on corporate governance.
The CBI said the Hampel Committee was right to focus on what good corporate governance could realistically achieve.
The report, published on Tuesday, said companies and shareholders should be flexible when it comes to working out how a company should perform.

The report by the Hampel committee, headed by ICI chairman Ronald Hampel, came out against "box ticking" where companies have to comply with lists of principles -- and also concluded recommendations should not distinguish between small and large companies.

"The CBI welcomes Hampel's focus on companies applying the principles of good corporate governance, rather than on completing a checklist, since this is a better way for shareholders to assess how well a company's board is performing," Britain's top industry organisation said in a statement.
